instruction: Navigate to the publications section on the Department of Justice website.

metadata.explanation: This task variation asks the agent to navigate to the publications section on justice.gov. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'justice.gov/publications' using the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match function. The task maintains similar structure and difficulty as the original task, changing from browsing forms to browsing publications.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree by reading the address bar element
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match properly uses regex search to find the pattern in the URL
Expected pattern is semantically correct: the regex pattern 'justice\.gov/publications' correctly identifies URLs in the publications section
Complete coverage: the evaluator checks the single key requirement - that the user navigated to the publications section
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string -> metric searches for pattern -> returns 1.0 if pattern found in URL
Runtime feasibility: accessibility tree can access Chrome address bar state, regex matching will work correctly
